deskSE:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one production 2D isometric transparent workstation desk sprite for a game.
Input 1 (desk.png): edit target and material/style reference, but its orientation is WRONG. Redraw the same light honey oak desk with charcoal drawer pedestal, two monitors, keyboard, mouse, small plant and mug from the newly specified viewpoint.
Primary request: rotate the entire physical desk one quarter turn around its vertical axis, keeping the game camera fixed. The seated worker will be BEHIND the desk at screen upper-left and look toward screen lower-right (east / SE, projected direction +32,+16). The desk must be oriented to receive this worker. Do NOT include the worker or any chair.
Geometry: desk width runs from screen lower-left to screen upper-right, along an upward-rising diagonal of about -0.5 slope. Its depth runs from upper-left to lower-right along +0.5 slope. The near working edge is at screen UPPER LEFT; an empty chair would sit there. The keyboard is adjacent to this upper-left working edge. The monitor pair is farther in front of the worker toward screen LOWER RIGHT. The display fronts face UPPER LEFT toward the unseen seated worker. Therefore the viewer mostly sees the dark charcoal BACKS of the monitors in the lower-right portion of the tabletop, including subtle rear vents, rather than blue screens facing the viewer. Keep the keyboard visible on the upper-left part of the tabletop. The pedestal and legs must be under the tabletop.
Composition: single isolated desk, isometric orthographic 2:1 projection, vertical legs, full uncropped object, roomy transparent margin. Desk long edges rise diagonally toward the right. No room, floor, cast glow, text, grid or additional objects.
Style: match the supplied crisp hand-illustrated 2D outlines, cel shading, restrained details, upper-left lighting, light oak and charcoal palette. This is an independently movable game sprite. Real transparent RGBA background, no baked backdrop or ground shadow.
